items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Dufresha had it as a gambling place when it first started. Called it B-25. Yeah. And the fellow named Paul Dufresha had it.

ctx.x: I was wondering if people have said to me too that they've noticed the New Orleans bands, or in general I'd say that you can put it that way, the colored bands play so much better together, and sometimes you think maybe the guys get along better together, or happier working together than some of the bands.
Well, there was one thing about it. They were very good.
He said, I told him, come around sometime, time out, a few lessons. So, Louis started to teach him.
